description: troy-mode hooks (F05 and F13): write scopes, read-only subagents, R19, R21, and R23 guards, commands a role leaves running, plugin reads, and the mode guard. Each exits at once outside troy-mode projects.

hooks.command: p=${TROY_MODE_PYTHON:-}; if [ -z "$p" ]; then case ${OSTYPE:-} in msys*|cygwin*) p=python;; *) p=python3;; esac; fi; if ! command -v "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1; then if [ -d "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.troy-mode" ]; then echo 'troy-mode: no Python 3.11 or newer found; set TROY_MODE_PYTHON' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0; fi; exec "$p" -I "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/troy-mode/hooks/troy_hook.py" SessionStart
